PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://brickschema.org/schema/brick/ontology/instances/2023/ref#>
SELECT ?z ?pname ?tsid ?q
WHERE {
  ?z brick:hasTag "Perimeter_top_ZN_2" .
  ?p brick:hasSubarea ?z .
  ?p a ?pc .
  ?p ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  OPTIONAL { ?p rdfs:label ?q }
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://brickschema.org/schema/brick/ontology/instances/2023/ref#>
SELECT ?z ?zlabel ?pc ?tsid
WHERE {
  ?p ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  ?p a ?pc .
  FILTER (contains(str(?pc), "Occupancy") || contains(str(?pc), "Presence") || contains(str(?pc), "People") || contains(str(?pc), "Count"))
  ?z brick:hasTag "Perimeter_top_ZN_2" .
  ?p brick:hasSubarea ?z .
  OPTIONAL { ?z rdfs:label ?zlabel }
}
LIMIT 100
